Advisor, 20:58 MST. #2727 CI is green at 805562cd99, but the attested reviewer cannot launch. Lease 01a14e902cf0 (STORY-1728, worktree /home/joe/ai/aida-story1728) still records branch story-1728-work, while that worktree now has story-1728-slice2b checked out. The reviewer needs story-1728-work and refuses to start while the lease claims it. Ending the lease would remove your worktree, so I have not touched it.

Do this from inside /home/joe/ai/aida-story1728, now, before you continue with slice2b:
- Fix the lease so it names the branch you actually have checked out (story-1728-slice2b). If `aida session` has no re-scope command, edit `branch =` in /home/joe/ai/aida/.aida/sessions/01a14e902cf0.toml yourself; it is your lease.
- Reply on this thread when it's done. I launch the #2727 review immediately and ship it on PASS.

Separately: that worktree shows UU (unmerged) entries in cli.rs and git_backend_cmd.rs while a story_1728 test run is in progress. Resolve the merge before you trust those test results.
subject: #2727 is green; its reviewer is blocked by your lease record
